sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Reserve destination capacity and speculative header
sourceSteps.custody: Source producer holds attempt plus required edge
sourceSteps.missingPremise: A speculative attempt is not a second canonical ticket; padding and rollback remain private

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Forwarding CAS wins before payload copy
sourceSteps.custody: Winner remains initialization and scan custodian
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Do not turn forwarding address into publish or acquire

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: CAS loser rolls back header and redirects root cell
sourceSteps.custody: Winner obligation remains live; only losing attempt disappears
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Current QNT has no speculative-attempt state or duplicate-CAS action

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Body copy then optional chunk boundary publication
sourceSteps.custody: Private copy or queued region plus live tail-edge producer
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Two abstract copy words represent progress classes, not concrete byte count

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: First field delegated to tail marking after possible chunk publish
sourceSteps.custody: Tail marker owns first edge while scan may own remaining fields
sourceSteps.plannedAction: discoverChild while parent remains scanning; settleParent later
sourceSteps.missingPremise: PAIR fast path and default skip first field; partition edge responsibility

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: End marker and next FIFO link written under chunk lock
sourceSteps.custody: Publisher retains pending batch; provisional link not readiness proof
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Outside-lock empty precheck is not a completed empty proof

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Ordered barriers, FIFO tail, unlock and notification
sourceSteps.custody: Batch custody commits to queue; signal does not create another task
sourceSteps.plannedAction: publishBatch at a justified in-lock commit cut
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Choose cut only after actual profile visibility and locked consumer proof

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Currently scanned chunk bypasses FIFO insertion
sourceSteps.custody: Local cursor and counted producer keep unfinished region live
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Already-scanned prefix, private suffix and tail dependencies require disjoint cover

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Local FIFO head moves, lock released, chunk scanned
sourceSteps.custody: Queued obligation becomes counted scanning obligation at head removal
sourceSteps.missingPremise: One FIFO chunk may represent many canonical object and edge obligations

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Remote FIFO head moves under remote lock then scan outside lock
sourceSteps.custody: Stealer is counted; source queue no longer owns the removed range
sourceSteps.missingPremise: No gap between removal and logical scanner custody; interrupted handoff stays unresolved

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: scan dispatch may mark/copy/publish children before parent scan returns
sourceSteps.custody: Parent scanning debt and accepted child debt coexist
sourceSteps.plannedAction: discoverChild before finishParent; canonical aliases reuse ticket
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Current finishScan both settles parent and first creates child root

sourceSteps.custody: Parent settles only after required edges have custody
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Do not require accepted children already scanned; do require no unknown handoff

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Worker decrements phase count after local and stealing loop
sourceSteps.custody: No producer rights or private/scanning/transit debt may escape count
sourceSteps.plannedAction: idle after complete participant ledger cut
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Native guard is procedural; QNT guard checks global queued and owner work

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Wait returns; count increments if phase count still positive
sourceSteps.custody: Awake seeker is counted even when notification was spurious
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Current QNT wake additionally requires queued work; direct counted projection fails otherwise

sourceSteps.nativeOperation: Native release can fail after foreign fields were cleared
sourceSteps.custody: Independent failure custodian retains payload and accepted descendants
sourceSteps.plannedAction: separate failure ledger and closed-phase admission
sourceSteps.missingPremise: Current copy/publish/dequeue are void paths, not transport APIs with rollback status

proposedProofTargets.premises: No ABA; winner live or known settled; immutable identity across redirect

proposedProofTargets.proposition: Child acceptance can precede parent scan completion without dropping either debt
proposedProofTargets.premises: Explicit edge coverage; canonical deduplication; same phase; no unresolved handoff
proposedProofTargets.existingSupport: gc_work_closure finishScan currently combines discovery and settlement

proposedProofTargets.proposition: Acquired chunk exposes initialized scan inputs while tail-edge debt stays owned
proposedProofTargets.premises: Actual macro profile; lock/barrier semantics; byte/layout and nonoverlap proof

proposedProofTargets.proposition: Head removal preserves total debt by transferring to counted scanner
proposedProofTargets.premises: Matching phase/range; exclusive dequeue; interruption policy
proposedProofTargets.existingSupport: acquire models queue-to-scanning as one step

proposedProofTargets.proposition: Rejected attempt, canonical winner and unknown effect retain distinct obligations
proposedProofTargets.premises: Pre-effect knowledge; durable acceptance; reconciliation; stable payload/handle
proposedProofTargets.existingSupport: Existing WorkAccounting lifetime theorem has no effect status

proposedProofTargets.proposition: Closed same-phase work cannot be relabeled to hide old raw aliases

proposedProofTargets.proposition: Native count changes match active seekers even with empty queue
